about_the_game:
Caduca is a tactical roguelike where creative combat is everything. Retro pixel art meets deep systemic gameplay that rewards clever positioning, elemental synergies, and thinking three moves ahead. Lead your team through randomized runs that test your ability to prepare for the unexpected and master interlocking systems.

MASTER TACTICAL COMBAT

Conjure water at your enemies' feet, then strike with lightning for an electrifying chain takedown. Pair a simple firebolt with a grease spell to ignite an inferno. Push foes off cliffs, or funnel enemies into kill zones. Every move on the battlefield counts.

BUILD YOUR TEAM

Assemble a squad from the last of the faithful, each bringing distinct abilities and upgrade paths that reshape how you play. Equip items that don't just boost stats, they transform your strategy, unlocking combos and tactics that make every run feel different.

DESCEND INTO HELL

Each run takes you from the ruins of a broken world, through haunted forests and crumbling strongholds, down into the burning halls of hell itself, where Caduca awaits. The world abandoned its gods. You're here to remind it why that was a mistake.

BATTLE HAUNTING FOES

Face possessed cultists, infectious zombie hordes, dividing slimes, and worse in encounters designed to punish predictability and reward improvisation.

With retro charm and hours of replayability, assemble your adventurers, harness synergies, and free your world from the grip of Caduca!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / macOS 10.9 / Ubuntu 14.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible, integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / macOS 10.12 / Ubuntu 18.04 or newer
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ compatible, any dedicated GPU or modern integrated graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Lead the last of the faithful on a tactical roguelike assault through a ruined world and into the gates of hell. Master deep elemental combat where every ability combines, every position matters, and every run demands new strategies.
